rangeRule.text: Each case is a share of the client's own measured base: a quarter, a half, and all of it. The same rule as FinOps IQ (ASM-FIN-040 to ASM-FIN-042). It is not a published benchmark: no public source gives a saving range for this lever (non-cloud-lever-sources.md, section 2), so no ceiling is applied.

levers.name: Non-SaaS software licence true-down
levers.baseText: Annual cost of on-premises, enterprise-agreement and publisher-licensed software that the client's own reconciliation shows is unused or over-entitled. SaaS and cloud-marketplace software are excluded: they sit in the FinOps IQ cloud line.
levers.label: Your measured unused licence cost, up to 100%, realisable at renewal; expected case is half.
